messages:
Elena: Quick heads-up: we started a staged bring-up for NovaLite-v3 (PTQ int8) in canary lane. Early perf looks good but structured toolcall parsing errors rose vs fp16. ops-bot posted the run: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/novalite-v3

Marcus: What numbers are we seeing? Is it concentrated on certain prompt types? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya (Eval): From the matrix: parse_fail = 2.9% (n=1100) vs fp16 baseline 0.11%. Failure taxonomy: trailing-free-text, missing-brace, array-truncation. Top offender templates are "walkthrough" and "multi-step checklist" prompts.

Theo: I pulled a few raw fragments: one example:
```
{"step":1,"action":"confirm","data":{"ok":true}}
Note: also check the env var before deploy.
```
It emits a valid object then a casual sentence immediately after, which our strict parser rejects.

Elena: Reproduced with streaming+kv-cache on, batch=16. Disabling kv-cache or switching to chunk_size=64 reduces the noise. Hypothesis: PTQ token rounding + streaming boundary produces a different punctuation token causing the model to continue with prose instead of stopping.

Marcus: Two-pronged plan: 1) short-term: opt-in non-blocking repair filter in front of the parser to find last balanced brace and attempt json loads; log both original and repaired. 2) long-term: quant/config sweep (per-channel vs per-tensor, symmetric vs asymmetric) and tokenizer alignment check. I'll run the quant sweep.

Priya (Eval): I'll run the reproducible set (top 250 failing prompts) across fp16, int8(per-tensor), int8(per-channel), and int8 with kv-cache off. Also add a streaming-slice emulation (frames of 28 tokens) to stress chunk boundaries.

ops-bot: Canary summary: model=NovaLite-v3(PTQ int8), samples=1100, parse_fail=2.9%, mean_rt=148ms, link=https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/novalite-v3/results

Theo: One nuance: some failures are strictly-valid JSON but contain extra fields or reordered keys; our linter currently enforces exact key set + order. Do we want to move to order-agnostic validation? That would reduce noise but might mask regressions.

Elena: Keep strict validation for signal. Implement repair as non-blocking: if repair succeeds, mark sample as "rescued" in telemetry with both payloads attached. If repair fails, surface as failure. We'll hold external rollout till either parse_fail < 0.5% on the eval matrix or rescue+telemetry is enabled and accepted by SRE.

Marcus: Action items: @Marcus -> run quant-config sweep and share results by EOD. @Priya -> run eval matrix + streaming-slice and post histograms. @Theo -> prototype json_repair adapter and ensure telemetry tagging. I'll coordinate rollback gating.

Priya (Eval): Adding a small regression test to CI with the extracted prompts so future PRs get alerted early.

Elena: Thanks team. We'll reconvene tomorrow AM with numbers. :thumbsup:
